name: "Sleeping Children" — early AI translation test (Nimbus space sci-fi)

mentions.name: "Sleeping Children" — early AI translation test (Nimbus space sci-fi)
mentions.description: An early AI translation test of the Finnish space sci-fi series, temporarily published online as an HTML page while the stories are prepared for book-on-demand publication. The translated story shares the heroine of the authors' debut book, and every short story in the series follows the same main characters visiting another star and another world.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We would like to publish our stories in book-on-demand format.

This is one of our early translation tests. I publish it here for a while for you:
https://media.nimbus.fi/tero/for_hackernews/sleeping_children.html
Please don't expect it to stay there forever.

It has the same heroine that is in our debut book:
https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nimbus_ja_t%C3%A4hdet
Every short story has the same main characters visiting an another star and an another world.
